method: each bundle tree extracted into its own directory and driven by replay_publish_gate.py (python -I). Real arms: the tree's own run_firm on the real sources and the real served index through a read-through client whose writes are captured in memory (every other mutation raises). Fixture arms: an in-memory versioned bucket under the tree's real HoldingsPublication. Trees: built = the standalone bundle built at the pin; live = the live per-firm standalone bundle; prior = the built tree with holdings_snapshot.py swapped for the live W2Wragr copy (FWD-14 isolated). Nothing is put anywhere.
